summary: Flex LNG Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 results press release dated November 11, 2026. Reported vessel operating revenues of $97.4 million, net income of $42.8 million, basic EPS of $0.79 and a TCE rate of $78,875 per day. The board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.75 per share. The release also describes a roughly $145.5 million sale and leaseback of Flex Enterprise with an approximately six-year bareboat charter and amended terms on the Flex Artemis and Flex Amber lease, a routine vessel financing rather than a corporate special situation. Watch quarterly charter coverage and spot-rate volatility.
